name: focus
description: A focus timer in the status line. /focus-timer 25 holds other mods' notifications and sounds until the break, then gives you what you missed in one summary.

minutes.title: Default length (minutes)
minutes.description: How long /focus-timer runs when you don't say

holdSounds.title: Hold sounds too
holdSounds.description: Mute other mods' sounds (chimes) while focusing
